model_sql:
WITH src AS (
    SELECT
        email,
        strpos(email, '@') AS at_pos
    FROM {{ source('legacy', 'customers') }}
    WHERE email IS NOT NULL
),
parts AS (
    SELECT
        SUBSTRING(email, at_pos + 1, length(rtrim(email))) AS domain
    FROM src
)
SELECT
    min(domain) AS domain,
    count(*) AS customers
FROM parts
GROUP BY rtrim(lower(domain))

explanation: This procedure takes each customer email, pulls out the part after the "@" as the email domain, and counts how many customers use each domain. It rebuilds the output table from scratch on each run. The model below matches T-SQL's case-insensitive, trailing-space-insensitive grouping, so "Gmail.com" and "gmail.com" count as one domain.
